meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上技能后，Claude会用vercel CLI部署网站到Vercel；部署前先本地构建，部署后检查状态和网址，确认正常才把链接给你。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布网页应用，或管理Vercel的项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: Claude会先本地构建，再部署并验证链接可用。

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署记录。
say.note: 它会运行 vercel ls 展示列表。

say.text: 给我的项目添加一个生产环境变量。
say.note: 通过管道方式添加，避免交互提示。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses the Vercel CLI to deploy web apps. It runs a local build first, then deploys and verifies the live URL before sharing it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude builds locally, then deploys and verifies the URL.
It runs vercel ls and shows the list.

say_en.text: Add a production env var to my Vercel project.
say_en.note: It adds the variable without an interactive prompt.
